usage: deskops edit task [-h] [--root ROOT] selector field value

Edit one task field.

positional arguments:
  selector     Task selector. Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem, or
               unique slug fragment where supported.
  field        Model field name to update; hyphens are accepted for
               underscores.
  value        New field value, parsed like an SLDB field value.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Target repository root.

Examples:
  deskops edit task task-fix-thing goal "Updated goal" --root .
  deskops edit task desk/drawer/tasks/<item>.md scope "Updated scope" --root .

A task selector may also be a desk/... path, relative to the repository root or absolute;
it names the task or drawer item whose file stem it ends in.
